runtime.framework: RuneLite Client Plugin API (Guice-based plugin framework)
runtime.version: Java 11 (build.gradle sets options.release = 11); Gradle 8.10.2 via committed wrapper

frontend.framework: Java Swing, custom-painted (no default Look & Feel chrome) via RuneLite's PluginPanel
frontend.styling: Hand-rolled theme constants and custom-painted components (CatastrophicTheme.java, RoundedPanel, StyledButton, etc.) - no CSS or external styling system

services: Runs entirely client-side inside the user's RuneLite client - no server component in this repo
Depends at runtime on a separately-hosted backend: the 'catabot' Discord bot's HTTP API (PLUGIN_API_PORT, default 8080), a sibling repo at ../catabot

key_packages.name: net.runelite:client
key_packages.purpose: RuneLite plugin API - Guice DI, ClientToolbar/NavigationButton, ChatMessageManager, ConfigManager, provisions OkHttpClient and Gson instances used throughout

key_packages.name: com.google.code.gson (Gson)
key_packages.purpose: JSON (de)serialization for API DTOs (api/dto package), using @SerializedName to map snake_case JSON to camelCase fields

key_packages.name: com.squareup.okhttp3 (OkHttp)
key_packages.version: unpinned - transitively resolved via net.runelite:client, instance injected by RuneLite
key_packages.purpose: Async HTTP client for calling the bot's plugin API (EventsApiClient)

key_packages.name: junit:junit
key_packages.purpose: Test-scope dependency; currently unused for real tests - src/test only contains a manual dev-launcher, not JUnit tests

key_packages.name: net.runelite:jshell
key_packages.purpose: Test-scope RuneLite dev-shell dependency used to boot a full client for local manual testing
